# Disclaimer

This `utils_references/` folder contains for now two functions and a schema.
This is really meant for a POC and should not be installed by anyone except @maxulysse.
But that was the easiest way to share functions and a schema between three different pipelines and still showcase the logic.
This might evolve in the future, possibly towards a proper plugin.

If you do so, please be aware that:

- @maxulysse has hacked the `main.nf` to test the functions and the schema
- This is really meant to evolve in the future and can be deleted at any moment without prior notice.

That being said, if you still want to use it or want to know more about it, please check the `#references` channel on the nf-core slack.

---
name: "nf-core/utils_references"
description: "Functionality for dealing with references that may be useful for any\
  \ Nextflow pipeline"
keywords:
- "utility"
- "pipeline"
- "references"
components: []
input:
- yaml_reference:
    type: "file"
    description: "References YAML file, validated against\n`subworkflows/nf-core/utils_references/schema_references.json`\n\
      and turned into a channel of reference entries.\n"
    pattern: "*.{yml,yaml}"
- param_file:
    type: "string"
    description: "Path to a file that overrides the reference file taken from the\
      \ YAML.\nWhen set, it is used for every reference entry; pass `null` to fall\n\
      back on `attribute_file`.\n"
- param_value:
    type: "string"
    description: "Value that overrides the reference value taken from the YAML. When\
      \ set,\nit is used for every reference entry; pass `null` to fall back on\n\
      `attribute_value`.\n"
- attribute_file:
    type: "string"
    description: "Name of the attribute in the references YAML holding the file to\n\
      extract, e.g. `fasta`.\n"
- attribute_value:
    type: "string"
    description: "Name of the attribute in the references YAML holding the value to\n\
      extract, e.g. `species`.\n"
- basepath:
    type: "string"
    description: "Base path substituted for the `${params.igenomes_base}` placeholder\
      \ in\nfile attributes read from the references YAML.\n"
output:
- references_file:
    type: "file"
    description: "Collected list of reference files, one entry per reference that\
      \ has the\nrequested file attribute (or for which `param_file` was given).\n\
      \nStructure: [ [ val(meta), path(file) ], ... ]\n"
- references_value:
    type: "string"
    description: "Collected list of reference values, one entry per reference that\
      \ has the\nrequested value attribute (or for which `param_value` was given).\n\
      \nStructure: [ [ val(meta), val(value) ], ... ]\n"
authors:
- "@maxulysse"
maintainers:
- "@maxulysse"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
